description: Na₅Li(PO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 47°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.77 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.73 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.83 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 101°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.62 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.81 Å. Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 63-65°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-1.97 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids and corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.56 Å) and one longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond length. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-70°. There are two shorter (1.56 Å) and two longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅P octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to five Na and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅P octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Li, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one P atom.
